name: EPIC 212303345
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 14.7 solar radii and 1.15 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212303345 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.679031 (16th-84th percentiles 14.00301-15.372203), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 6,148 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.15 solar masses and 14.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,862 K at its surface.
